name: Family Matters
overview: Scripture reveals that family is a divine institution established by God, beginning with His creation of man and woman in His image and His command to multiply and steward the earth (Genesis 1:26, 28). The sacred union of marriage is affirmed as a man leaves his parents to unite with his wife, becoming one flesh (Genesis 2:24). Honoring parents is commanded with the promise of a long life (Exodus 20:12), while children are portrayed as a blessing and heritage from the Lord (Psalms 127:3). Furthermore, the responsibility to train children in the ways of the Lord is emphasized, ensuring their faithfulness throughout life (Proverbs 22:6).
